resources.string: Izinhlelo zokusebenza ezise-lisini kuphela ezibona i-Play Store njengesifaki saso, ngakho izinhlelo zokusebenza ezidinga ukufakwa kwe-Play (isibonelo i-Notein) zihlala zisebenza. Ezinye izinhlelo zokusebenza ne-Play Store zisabona isifaki sangempela. Kusebenza ngokushesha.
Lolu hlelo lokusebenza luzobona futhi isifaki saso sangempela.

Izinhlelo zokusebenza ezise-lisini kuphela ezibona uhlobo, umkhiqizi nemodeli yenye idivayisi, isibonelo ukuze i-Netflix isakaze nge-HDR10, HDR10+ ne-Dolby Vision. Thepha uhlelo lokusebenza ukuze ushintshe idivayisi yalo; inkambu engenalutho igcina inani langempela. Amasevisi e-Google Play ne-Play Store njalo abona idivayisi yangempela. Qala kabusha ukuze usebenzise ushintsho.
Kudingeka ukuqala kabusha ukuze kusetshenziswe ubunikazi bedivayisi bezinhlelo zokusebenza.
